description: Help Mutiso bring in the harvest: greetings, counting and sharing.

choices.label: Nîmwega. (I am fine.)
choices.reply: Mutiso beams. "Nîmwega! Then the harvest will be sweet today."

choices.label: Nesa! (Greetings!)
choices.reply: Mutiso laughs. "Nesa! Come, there is work and laughter waiting."

scene1.culture: Among the Kamba, greeting everyone you meet in the morning is a must. A day starts with respect.
scene1.translation: "How are you, visitor!" A warm Kamba morning greeting.

choices.label: Nîmwega sana! (Very good!)
choices.reply: "Nîmwega sana!" Mutiso nods proudly at the full baskets.

choices.label: Îmwe! (One!)
choices.reply: You count along with him, laughing as the numbers tumble out.

scene2.culture: The Kamba are famous farmers and traders; harvest season brings the whole village together.
scene2.translation: "One, two, three!" Mutiso counts the baskets of maize.

scene3.culture: Sharing the harvest with neighbours is a deep Kamba value; no one eats alone.
scene3.translation: "Thank you very much!" The sun sets over the full granary.

title: Mutiso's Harvest Day
